prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ORIGINAL GAME PROP DESIGN, a compact SAFE, two animation design keyframes side by side on ONE wide transparent canvas: CLOSED on left, OPEN on right. Same safe design, identical body scale, identical fixed three-quarter camera from slightly above/right, identical floor baseline, each complete object fully inside its own half with generous empty margins. No labels or dividing line. This is a fresh design, not an edit of any blue-and-gold mechanical safe. STYLE REFERENCES: Image 1 supplies the game's hand-painted opaque color-plane language and purposeful brush shapes. Image 2 supplies selective refinement and finished anime readability. Image 3 supplies Arknights' readable economical shape hierarchy, restrained color quantities, local light and negative space ONLY; do NOT copy any node icon, black circular backing, symbols or fine decorative traces. Image 4 is the NAI neutral color rough ONLY; its refrigerator-like proportions, vents, tiny knob and caster wheels are WRONG and must NOT be copied. SAFE DESIGN: square compact charcoal painted-steel box with a broad pale warm-gray/ivory FRONT DOOR, small softened chamfers, ONE simple prominent circular graphite combination knob with an inset center and just one small index mark, one short thick horizontal lever whose end carries a SMALL VERMILION RED accent. Two discreet integral hinges on the LEFT; one plain recessed door seam. No other trim or decoration. The knob and lever form one clear visual focus. No rows of screws, exposed bolts, armor plates, concentric decorative rings, graduated scales, gold, brass, shiny chrome, vents, slots, wheels or labels. PALETTE: about 65% warm gray-white, 30% graphite/charcoal with nuanced cool violet-gray shadows, 3% muted vermilion, tiny soft white light. Side plane is charcoal, NOT green or saturated blue. Paint the safe with connected opaque broad color masses and several controlled secondary midtone shapes, firm handmade edges and a few selective thin structural accents. Craftsmanship is in the shape, restrained light, edge variety and clean material transitions, not extra parts. Surfaces are matte, refined and quiet; avoid rough dirty smears, all-over texture, vector flat fill, triangular facets, thick cartoon outlines, photoreal reflections or glossy 3D game inventory rendering. CLOSED FRAME: door flush, dark round knob fully visible, small vermilion lever end. OPEN FRAME: same door swings outward LEFT 85 degrees on the same hinge, showing a simple thick edge and plain EMPTY internal compartment. Interior emits concentrated pearly WHITE light with a very faint warm blush, two or three delicate spark glints and a short restrained painterly light spill. NO gold light filling the whole body; NO reward objects, coins, gems or bars. Transparent alpha0 background and soft local glow fading to alpha0. No floor, background field, circular backing, text, watermarks or checkerboard.
